name: Plausible Diversity Metric
definition: Computes plausibility and coverage of an estimated set of transforms against a set of plausible transforms. Plausibility is the average minimum distance from each estimated transform to its nearest plausible transform. Coverage is the average minimum distance from each plausible transform to its nearest estimated transform.
summary: The Plausible Diversity Metric evaluates estimated object poses against plausible references using bidirectional plausibility and coverage scores to measure accuracy and diversity.
